script.spokenHook: Most altcoins are bleeding today, but Pyth Network just bucked the trend.
segmentLines: Pyth climbed over 12% to about $0.085, defying the broader market downturn.
It is trading almost 1.6% below the four-hour high with a neutral RSI of 51.
Over $81 million traded today, representing a notable 12% turnover of its entire market cap.
script.takeaway: Strong uptrend continues despite market pressure
script.cta: Is this Pyth rally sustainable or just a short-term bounce? Tell me below and follow for more.
